name: client-360
description: Customer 360 Reinvented: an Accenture accelerator: a worklist-first commercial-credit relationship cockpit for C&I bankers, drivable in natural chat. Reads the book live from Salesforce (nCino + FSC) via the org-hosted Customer360 MCP server (28 tools: 10 reads plus 8 governed stage/execute write pairs, a second-hop completion tool and one stage-only renewal, per-user OAuth) plus Boom-spread financials, and renders a full React application as an interactive Cowork artifact: needs-action worklist with reason codes, per-account Activity audit trail, exposure & collateral, covenants with effective-challenge validation, relationship graph, whitespace, structural early-warning signals, a page-agnostic AI chat, and a data-gated Client Actions control center. Governed writes follow one discipline: stage the plan, show the org's warnings verbatim, the banker confirms, execute behind a single-use decision token bound to the running identity, verify by re-query. Guided workflows cover a client request becoming a package-anchored loan modification, package-scoped bulk covenant review, package-anchored collateral valuation, service requests, annual reviews, risk rating reviews, new facilities and renewals. Use when a banker asks to open the Customer 360, pull up the relationship view, work the needs-action queue, or act on a client request.
